description: Click any jargon in a medical note for a plain-English explanation linked to its source line.

notes.note: Explaining jargon in place while preserving the link to the source line is genuinely trust-aware product design — most AI summaries fail exactly here. But the buyers are portal vendors (EHRs, glacial sales) and the consumer tier is $9/mo from chronic-care patients — a real niche but a small one. Solid singles, not a home run.
Term click->glossary explanation; translate-all OK, zero errors.
